card.name: Start of country names in other languages
card.fires_on: The first piece of a country or region name written in a non-English language, such as Spanish, French or Italian, mostly inside book titles or citations. It fires before the rest of the name, such as Inglaterra, Italie, Escocia or Bretagne.

modes.label: Spanish place names in titles
modes.description: Opening pieces of Spanish country or region names inside a Spanish book title.
modes.example: Historia de lo sucedido en<< Esc>>ocia é Inglaterra en los

modes.label: French or Italian place names
modes.description: Opening pieces of countries or regions in French or Italian phrases, often after d'.

modes.label: Regional names in English text
modes.description: Opening piece of a foreign-language name for a region, given in a parenthetical gloss.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward country names such as Germany, Italy, France and Spain.
card.plain: It fires when a country name in another language has just begun, and it predicts that a country name is coming.
